verdict.rationale: x402's own batch-settlement scheme lets an agent make thousands of granular paid interactions and settle them together in one onchain transaction. That is a documented bulk-processing capability for payments, offered on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum and World. It is narrow, though: it amortizes settlement rather than letting a user run arbitrary bulk actions across many items, and Bazaar search caps results at 20 resources. Missing for 10: general bulk operations beyond payment settlement (e.g., bulk refunds, multi-resource actions in one call), batch settlement on Solana, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch settlement working at scale.
